rec.name: Cart Free Gift & Free Shipping Progress Bar
rec.status: Built — delivered and approved (client uses only the shipping bar; free gift hidden by default)

what.text: A progress bar at the top of the cart drawer that shows how close the customer is to reward thresholds. In the screenshots there are two milestones: a free gift at €80 and free shipping at €120. Each milestone has an icon pill (gift, truck) that gets a checkmark once reached. A dynamic message sits under the bar, e.g. 'Only €20.10 left until free shipping', 'You've unlocked free shipping!' or 'Congratulations! Add your free gift!'. When the gift threshold is met, the gift product appears in the cart as a line item at 100% off ('Kostenlos' with the original price struck through and a 'You save' note). The free gift part is optional. It is hidden until enabled in theme settings, so the bar can run as a pure shipping-progress bar.

why.text: The goal-gradient effect: people speed up as they get closer to a goal, so a visible gap ('only €20.10 left') pushes shoppers to add one more item and raises AOV. A free gift or free shipping works as a concrete, loss-averse reward, because customers don't want to miss out once they are close. Showing several milestones on one bar makes the reward ladder tangible. The strikethrough price and 'You save' text make the gift's value explicit. The icon and checkmark change on completion gives instant positive feedback.

how.text: Implement it in the cart drawer (the original build was made for the Focal theme). It compares the cart subtotal to the configured thresholds, fills the bar proportionally and swaps the message and icon states (default vs. active). The free-gift logic uses a minimum amount and a selected gift product, which can be added automatically or manually via a prompt. The gift line item is discounted 100%. Colors, border style and icons are editable under Theme settings > Cart > Progress Bar and Cart Free Gift. Message text is edited via Edit language > Cart > 'Free shipping remaining html'. In the final version the icons are uploaded as images (default and active) rather than pasted SVG code. Free gift settings stay hidden until enabled.

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with a cart drawer (built for Focal; the dev reports it can have issues on other themes). Needs a gift product, selected in theme settings, and a way to discount it 100%, presumably via the theme's gift logic or a discount (implementation not visible). The free shipping threshold (€120 in the screenshots) is not documented in the ticket; it presumably comes from the live shipping calculation or shipping rates (inference). The client reported a cart error ('Please try again in a few minutes') after editing the Cart Free Gift settings. The dev could not reproduce it and suspected a third-party app conflict. The fix was to rebuild the changes on a duplicate of the live theme. Test against installed apps. The same ticket also ordered a separate 'Video with text overlay' section, which is not covered by this record.
